action_name: 许可后的低跳与落地能力观察
source_checklist: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/动作分步骤示范图制作清单_v1.0.md
generation_mode: built-in image_gen only, one image per call
notes: 未使用旧单图复用，未覆盖源清单、旧进度JSON或现有单图；原生成文件留存。检查结果为示范图视觉核对，不作为真人动作测试或负荷证据。

records.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: single photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, step 01 of four of a very low two-foot jump and landing sequence. Generate only one image, portrait 1024x1536.
Input images: reference images 1, 2 and 3 are visual identity/style references only, not pose targets. Match this exact East Asian adult woman, facial features, natural slim-average adult body, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt and fitted dark charcoal-gray long trousers. Add plain unbranded white athletic shoes.
Scene/backdrop: seamless light gray-blue studio floor and backdrop, soft diffuse studio light with natural floor shadow. Empty level floor, no props, no platforms.
Composition/framing: fixed oblique full-body camera from her front-left side (a three-quarter side view), woman facing screen right. Camera at mid-body height with natural perspective, head and complete hands and both feet fully in frame; moderate comfortable margin over head and below shoes. Subject around 75% of canvas height, central. Feet clearly separately visible rather than occluded. Stable floor origin directly beneath her.
Exact pose: she is standing quietly upright at rest, both feet planted entirely flat on the same level floor, feet hip-width apart, knees comfortably straight but not hyperextended, trunk upright, arms and open relaxed hands naturally resting beside her thighs, gaze horizontal toward screen right. This is the standing preparation BEFORE bending or jumping. Feet under her hips, no forward step.
Anatomy and contact: believable limb proportions, continuous hip/knee/ankle anatomy, correct natural fingers, both shoes touch floor securely. Realistic photographic texture.
Constraints: only one woman, one pose, same reference identity/clothing/hair/light/background. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, motion trails, borders, collage, watermark, brand logos, equipment or heavy weights. Do not copy the references' raised arm poses.

qa.method: 逐张 view_image 实际视觉检查
qa.identity_clothing_background: 同一东亚女性、黑马尾、白色短袖T恤、深灰长裤与无商标白运动鞋；柔和灰蓝棚拍、自然地面阴影一致。
qa.action: 双脚全足底接地、髋宽站距、直立稳站、双臂自然垂于身侧，完整双足及空旷原地落点可见。
qa.anatomy_proportions: 头、躯干、上/前臂、大小腿长度自然，关节连续；双足与鞋完整，无明显多肢、断肢、手指融合，斜侧透视合理。
qa.camera_group_consistency: 全组同一斜侧全身机位，面向画面右，人物尺度和地面基准整体一致；准备/落地图脚位与底图视觉偏差很小，无跨步/远跳。
qa.text_and_layout: 单姿势原始照片，无文字、编号、箭头、拼贴、水印或额外设备。

records.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: single photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photo, step 03 of a VERY LOW two-foot jump, portrait 1024x1536.
Image 1 is the edit target and exact identity/camera/background/wardrobe reference. Keep identical woman, face, realistic body proportions, ponytail, plain white short-sleeve shirt, charcoal long trousers and white logo-free sneakers. Keep exactly the same front-left oblique full-body camera facing screen right, camera position, perspective, crop, image scale, gray-blue seamless studio light/floor/backdrop and original floor origin.
Change ONLY pose to a tiny vertical two-foot jump caught in mid-air: she is directly above her original footprint, NOT traveling forwards. BOTH feet are simultaneously off the floor at the same small height, soles mostly level and a clearly visible narrow gap of about 3 to 5 centimeters between the lowest part of BOTH shoe soles and the floor below. Include separate natural shadows on the unchanged level floor directly underneath both feet so the air gap is unmistakable. This is a tiny hop, maximum 3-5cm, not a high jump. Lift her whole body by this tiny amount without changing its scale. Legs almost extended naturally, knees slightly soft around 10 degrees, ankles gently plantarflexed but neither shoe touches floor. Feet still hip-width apart, no split legs, no tucked knees, no raised platform. Upper body controlled and nearly upright. Arms have swung a little forward, elbows comfortably flexed and hands around lower rib/waist height, no raised overhead arms. Keep complete head, hair, natural hands and both shoes within the original frame.
Maintain exact original woman's identity and unaltered clothing, lighting and studio setting. Anatomically natural proportions and joints, all fingers believable.
Do not let one foot stay grounded. No dramatic high leap, no forward long jump, no step stool, no equipment, no text/numbers/arrows/collage/border/logo/watermark/ghost pose.

records.prompt:

Asset type: single photorealistic rehabilitation exercise demonstration photo, step 04 of a tiny two-foot jump sequence: controlled landing, portrait 1024x1536.

Keep the same woman and exact face, ponytail, white plain T-shirt, charcoal trousers, white logo-free athletic shoes, body proportions, front-left oblique full-body camera facing screen right, camera position/crop/scale, seamless gray-blue background and level studio floor, and identical soft light.
Change ONLY to the stable landing pose AFTER a very low hop: BOTH feet have returned to their exact original location and are now completely flat and in full contact with the floor. Hip-width stance, no step or forward travel. To clearly distinguish this landing from the preparatory image, move BOTH arms from behind hips to naturally bent IN FRONT of lower chest/waist for balance, elbows around 80-100 degrees and open relaxed fingers, no arms overhead. Head, both hands and full shoes in the frame. Natural grounded shadows in direct contact underneath the soles, no gap.
Match all visual identity and studio invariants. Natural anatomical length and joint continuity. Do not change the camera view, footwear or standing footprint, no text/numbers/arrows/logos/watermark/collage/props/platforms/duplicate limbs.
